intro: OpenAI's models have generated mathematical proofs in exponential time complexity and solved previously unsolved problems in math and physics, marking a shift from AI capability announcements to concrete research contributions. Anthropic disclosed in its $2 trillion IPO filing that AI may pose "catastrophic or existential risks to humanity," while China's AI sector faces a cooling market as investors weigh sustainability concerns against slowing profit growth. Microsoft is offering voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees as it reallocates resources toward AI infrastructure investments, while Nvidia and Meta deepen their partnership with a $3 billion investment commitment.

whitelist.title: Artificial Intelligence
whitelist.desc: Artificial intelligence is more a part of our lives than ever before. While some might call it hype and compare it to NFTs or 3D TVs, AI is causing a sea change in nearly every part of the technology industry. OpenAI’s ChatGPT is arguably the best-known AI chatbot around, but with Google pushing Gemini, Microsoft building Copilot, and Apple working to make Siri good, AI is probably going to be in the spotlight for a very long time. At The Verge, we’re exploring what might be possible with AI — a...
